worldFact.fact: At 430 metres (1,411 feet) below global sea level, the shores of the Dead Sea mark the lowest land point on Earth. The extreme barometric pressure creates roughly 8% higher oxygen concentration than sea-level air and natural protection against solar UVB rays.
